terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.desc: Official terms and conditions governing the Cilaaa Community platform.

sections.title: Audio Rights & Licensing
sections.content: Users retain full responsibility for verifying copyrights and licensing for any audio converted, edited, or uploaded to Roblox. Cilaaa Community serves as a technical tooling pipeline and is not liable for third-party copyright claims.

sections.title: Account & API Security
sections.content: Roblox Open Cloud credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM on isolated servers. We recommend using keys with minimal necessary scopes (least privilege).

sections.title: Service Plans & Billing
sections.content: Payments are processed securely via verified gateways (QRIS, GoPay, PayPal, Touch 'n Go). Quotas, feature entitlements, and Discord server roles are provisioned instantly upon successful transaction confirmation.

sections.title: Platform Evolution
sections.content: Cilaaa Community continuously updates its pipeline infrastructure and tools to maintain peak performance and developer security across the community.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: Data protection and privacy commitments for Cilaaa Community users.

sections.title: Processed Information
sections.content: We process Discord IDs, usernames, configuration preferences, and conversion metadata strictly for authentication, role synchronization, and service delivery.

sections.title: Data Storage & Encryption
sections.content: Sensitive API credentials are encrypted with military-grade AES-256-GCM. Transient audio files are stored in private isolated storage and routinely purged according to retention limits.

sections.title: Third-Party Integrations
sections.content: Authentication operates through official Discord OAuth. Roblox uploads connect directly to Roblox Open Cloud endpoints under Roblox's terms.

sections.title: Data Deletion & Support
sections.content: Users can disconnect credentials or request conversion history deletion at any time through account settings or via our official Discord support portal.
